body_card.intro: This is what astrological tradition links to the body. It is not medical advice: for any health concern, see a doctor.
body_card.sign.aries: the head, face, brain, eyes, upper skull and facial skin
body_card.sign.taurus: the neck, throat, vocal cords, thyroid gland and cerebellum
body_card.sign.gemini: the shoulders, arms, hands, lungs, breathing and nervous system
body_card.sign.cancer: the breasts, chest, stomach, womb and digestive tract
body_card.sign.leo: the heart, spine, back, circulation and thymus gland
body_card.sign.virgo: the abdomen, small intestine, bowels, spleen and digestion
body_card.sign.libra: the kidneys, lower back, adrenal glands and urinary tract
body_card.sign.scorpio: the genitals, reproductive organs, colon, bladder, prostate and excretory system
body_card.sign.sagittarius: the thighs, hips, sciatic nerve and liver
body_card.sign.capricorn: the knees, bones, skeleton, joints, teeth, skin and gallbladder
body_card.sign.aquarius: the lower legs, shins, calves, ankles and circulation
body_card.sign.pisces: the feet, toes, lymphatic system, mucous membranes and thalamus
body_card.planet.sun.rules: core vitality, the heart, the spine and the basic constitution
body_card.planet.sun.stress: low vitality, strain on the heart and spine, and inherited weak points
body_card.planet.sun.care: Pace effort and protect rest, because vitality spent all at once is slow to come back.
body_card.planet.moon.rules: the body's fluids, the stomach, the breasts, the lymphatic system and the nervous responses
body_card.planet.moon.stress: flare-ups that follow moods, fluid imbalance and stomach upsets
body_card.planet.moon.care: Regular meals, sleep and calm help, because stress that is not felt tends to show up in the body.
body_card.planet.mercury.rules: the nervous system, reflexes, breathing and speech
body_card.planet.mercury.stress: nervous tension, shallow breathing, anxiety felt in the body and worry about health
body_card.planet.mercury.care: Slow breathing, breaks from screens and a quiet mind before sleep help to settle the nerves.
body_card.planet.venus.rules: the veins, the throat, the kidneys and the parathyroid glands
body_card.planet.venus.stress: skin trouble such as rashes or eczema, kidney strain and too much rich food
body_card.planet.venus.care: Water, simple food and moderation in pleasures keep this side of the body clear.
body_card.planet.mars.rules: the muscles, the adrenal glands, red blood cells and physical heat
body_card.planet.mars.stress: high fevers, acute inflammation, infections, cuts, burns and injuries
body_card.planet.mars.care: Regular, vigorous exercise discharges the heat safely. Haste and anger are what turn it into accidents.
body_card.planet.jupiter.rules: the liver, the arteries, the hips and growth
body_card.planet.jupiter.stress: overindulgence, weight gain, high blood pressure, high cholesterol and blood sugar
body_card.planet.jupiter.care: Moderation is the medicine: too much of a good thing is this planet's usual cost.
body_card.planet.saturn.rules: the skeleton, bones, teeth, knees, skin and joints
body_card.planet.saturn.stress: chronic conditions, stiffness, blockages, stones, arthritis, chills and fatigue
body_card.planet.saturn.care: Warmth, steady movement and patience help, because these conditions build slowly and ease slowly.
body_card.planet.uranus.rules: the nervous system and sudden changes in the body
body_card.planet.uranus.stress: spasms, cramps, sudden shocks, fractures and erratic symptoms
body_card.planet.uranus.care: Regular routines and care with sudden moves protect a body that reacts fast.
body_card.planet.neptune.rules: the immune system and the body's sensitivities
body_card.planet.neptune.stress: sensitivity to drugs and alcohol, vague or hard-to-name symptoms, and illness that follows the mind
body_card.planet.neptune.care: Go easy on alcohol and medicines, and ask for a second opinion when symptoms are unclear.
body_card.planet.pluto.rules: renewal of the body, elimination and deep repair
body_card.planet.pluto.stress: a build-up of toxins, problems with elimination, and long recoveries
body_card.planet.pluto.care: Cleansing habits, rest after crises and thorough check-ups support deep repair.
body_card.planet.north_node.rules: breath and the balance between air and heat in the body
body_card.planet.north_node.stress: breathing trouble and imbalances that are hard to pin down
body_card.planet.north_node.care: Fresh air, steady breathing and regular routines help to keep the balance.
body_card.house.1.title: Physical Constitution & Head/Face
body_card.house.1.rules: The 1st House rules the physical body, baseline vitality, the overall constitution, and the head and face.
body_card.house.1.natal: In the 1st House, %s puts its energy straight into the body and how it looks.
body_card.house.1.transit: While %s passes through the 1st House, its energy goes straight into the body for a while.
body_card.house.6.title: Daily Routines, Work & Health Vulnerabilities
body_card.house.6.rules: The 6th House rules daily habits, work routines, maintenance of the body and acute illness.
body_card.house.6.natal: In the 6th House, %s works through daily habits and work, and strain there turns into symptoms.
body_card.house.6.transit: While %s passes through the 6th House, daily routines and work strain are where the body feels it.
body_card.house.8.title: Long Processes, Surgery & Elimination
body_card.house.8.rules: The 8th House rules long health processes, surgery, elimination and the deep repair that follows a crisis.
body_card.house.8.natal: In the 8th House, %s works through long processes, elimination and recovery after a crisis.
body_card.house.8.transit: While %s passes through the 8th House, recovery, elimination and long processes are in focus.
body_card.house.12.title: Rest, Hospitals & Hidden Conditions
body_card.house.12.rules: The 12th House rules rest and retreat, hospitals, hidden or hard-to-find conditions, and the link between mind and body.
body_card.house.12.natal: In the 12th House, %s works out of sight, through rest, retreat and the mind.
body_card.house.12.transit: While %s passes through the 12th House, rest and the mind's effect on the body need attention.
body_card.sig.mars_sun.title: Vital Core & Overexertion
body_card.sig.mars_sun.outcome: Mars on the Sun amplifies vitality but tends to overtax strength: overexertion of the heart and circulation, high fevers or acute inflammation, and, because effort is impulsive, a higher risk of accidents, cuts and sudden injuries.
body_card.sig.mars_moon.title: Functional Health & Somatic Stress
body_card.sig.mars_moon.outcome: Mars on the Moon sets feelings against drive. It tends toward functional flare-ups, shocks to the nervous system, stomach distress and skin eruptions, and unspoken stress or anger can turn into migraines, acid reflux or feverish spells.
body_card.sig.mars_uranus.title: Sudden Strain & Accidents
body_card.sig.mars_uranus.outcome: Mars with Uranus joins heat to suddenness. Tradition links it to accidents, injuries, spasms and sudden skin eruptions, so haste and risk-taking are the things to watch.
body_card.sig.saturn_venus.title: Skin & Kidneys
body_card.sig.saturn_venus.outcome: Saturn on Venus restricts what Venus keeps clear. Tradition links it to skin conditions and to strain on the kidneys and urinary tract.
body_card.sig.mars_saturn.title: Joints & Stiffness
body_card.sig.mars_saturn.outcome: Mars against Saturn is drive meeting a wall. Tradition links it to stiffness, joint pain, arthritis and strain injuries, especially when effort is forced.
body_card.sig.saturn_sun.title: Heart & Vitality Under Pressure
body_card.sig.saturn_sun.outcome: Saturn on the Sun weighs on vitality. Tradition links it to heart and circulation strain, low energy and slow recovery.
body_card.sig.sun_uranus.title: Heart Rhythm & Sudden Strain
body_card.sig.sun_uranus.outcome: Uranus on the Sun brings sudden swings in energy. Tradition links it to strain on the heart's rhythm and to nervous exhaustion.
body_card.sig.pluto_sun.title: Deep Strain on Vitality
body_card.sig.pluto_sun.outcome: Pluto on the Sun pushes vitality to its limits. Tradition links it to strain on the heart, burnout and the need for deep recovery.
body_card.sig.moon_saturn.title: Mood & Chronic Strain
body_card.sig.moon_saturn.outcome: Saturn on the Moon cools the body's responses. Tradition links it to low mood felt in the body, slow digestion and chronic, nagging complaints.
body_card.sig.moon_uranus.title: Nerves & Sudden Flare-ups
body_card.sig.moon_uranus.outcome: Uranus on the Moon unsettles the nervous responses. Tradition links it to sudden flare-ups, restless sleep and nervous strain.
body_card.sig.moon_neptune.title: Sensitivity & Unclear Symptoms
body_card.sig.moon_neptune.outcome: Neptune on the Moon makes the body sensitive and porous. Tradition links it to sensitivities, unclear symptoms and illness that follows the mind.
body_card.sig.mars_mercury.title: Nerves Under Pressure
body_card.sig.mars_mercury.outcome: Mars on Mercury speeds the nerves up. Tradition links it to nervous tension, headaches and stress felt in the breathing.
body_card.sig.mercury_saturn.title: Nerves & Breathing Held Back
body_card.sig.mercury_saturn.outcome: Saturn on Mercury slows and tightens the nerves. Tradition links it to worry, tension and breathing that is held back.
body_card.sig.mercury_uranus.title: Overstimulated Nerves
body_card.sig.mercury_uranus.outcome: Uranus on Mercury overstimulates the nerves. Tradition links it to restlessness, sudden nervous strain and trouble switching off.
body_card.sig.mercury_neptune.title: Nerves & the Mind's Effect on the Body
body_card.sig.mercury_neptune.outcome: Neptune on Mercury blurs the line between worry and the body. Tradition links it to anxiety, vague symptoms and health worries that grow when the mind is tired.
